title: Account Executive, Commercial, ANZ
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Account Executive, ANZ, is responsible for expanding sales within the territory of Australia and New Zealand by selling the Jamf platform experience. The role leads growth with both new and existing customers, as well as Reseller and Integrator partners.

This position is responsible for driving thought leadership at multiple levels within accounts, concentrating on adoption strategies for implementing the Jamf platform, and assisting in formulating and guiding business validation cases in order to expedite adoption.

This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to work from our Sydney office at 156 Clarence Street, Level 5, Sydney NSW 2000, three days per week. Applicants must be currently based in Sydney or within a reasonable commuting distance of the Sydney office and have unrestricted work rights in Australia. At this time, we are unable to offer employer sponsorship or support employer-administered work authorisation for this position. #LI-Hybrid

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Learn and understand prospects’ and customers’ Apple platform adoption, growth strategies, and business plans
  • Prescribe near-term and long-term solutions with the Jamf platform experience to meet customers’ goals
  • Structure sales agreements with clients and channel partners
  • Develop expertise and meaningful relationships with key stakeholders at customer accounts, including bridging relationships to executive-level stakeholders
  • Increase Jamf mindshare and establish a strategic position within assigned accounts
  • Manage territory and vertical market sales campaigns while working with a diverse set of stakeholders and partners
  • Create and manage business, sales, and territory account plans to achieve and exceed assigned targets
  • Execute against sales plans and adjust approach as required in response to opportunities or challenges
  • Accurately submit regular sales forecasts based on quarterly targets
  • Use Salesforce, Clari, and other sales systems to document and manage sales account activities
  • Sell effectively within a competitive landscape and maintain awareness of competitive technologies
  • Perform all responsibilities in alignment with Jamf’s values, policies, and applicable legal and ethical standards
  • As a Jamf employee you will be expected to travel between up to 50 % to attend events specific to your role including international travel.

What we are looking for:

  • 4-years' Bachelor's Degree (preferred)
  • A combination of education and relevant experience can be considered
  • 4+ years of selling experience in a related software industry with demonstrated quota achievement
  • Experience selling in both direct and indirect (channel) sales models
  • Experience with customer-centric and solution-selling sales methodologies
  • Proven ability to work effectively with business and IT contacts at all levels within a variety of organisations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Business-level English proficiency
  • Highly trusted individual who maintains high standards of professionalism and integrity
  • Self-starter who takes initiative and works effectively with limited direction
  • Ability to manage multiple sales opportunities simultaneously
  • Proficiency with CRM tools and standard business productivity applications
  • Experience with Apple technology in a commercial environment (Preferred)
  • Ability to work across different environments, including Jamf offices, customer sites, and partner locations
  • Reasonable adjustments may be made to enable individuals to perform the inherent requirements of the role

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.


What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees.
